title: Cards
description: Every support card upstream or GameTora has, with what the site shows (generated/cards.json, built by `pnpm build-cards`, see scripts/lib/cards.js). The tier list calculation's inputs are in generated/card_stats/.

id.description: The card id (the same on both servers and on GameTora).

charId.description: GameTora's character id (for group cards, one member's); null without GameTora's data.

type.description: The tier list's stat key, or group (ranked with friend cards). Codes: tierlist/join-cards.js TYPE_CODES.

name.description: The character's name (a group card's: the group's). en: Global's where it has the character, else GameTora's.

title.description: The card's title, e.g. "[Tracen Academy]". en: Global's (data/global_cards.json), else GameTora's.

release.description: Release dates per server (gl: data/global_cards.json, jp: GameTora), null when not out (or unknown).

source.description: How the card is obtained (GameTora's `obtained`); empty when unknown.

icon.description: Square icon (upstream's where it has the card, else GameTora's).
